title: The note on my fridge was mine 📝
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 4:04 in the morning, I found a note on my fridge in my own handwriting.

scenes.narration: At 4:04 in the morning, I found a note on my fridge in my own handwriting.
I live alone. The paper was still warm.
The note said, do not let him back in. He is not me.
Then I heard three slow knocks at my front door.
I walked down the hall. Through the peephole, I saw a figure. Same coat. Same posture. Hand raised to knock again.
He spoke softly. It is me. I forgot my keys. Open up. It was my voice. My exact tone.
I went back to the kitchen. There was a second line on the note. Written fresh. He will say he forgot his keys.
The knocking stopped. A key turned slowly in the lock. The door opened. A voice from the hall said, I told you not to read it.
Then I noticed the handwriting. Every letter leaned the way mine does. But I write with my left hand. The note was written with the right. Which one of us was lying?
So tell me. Do you trust the note, or trust me?
